title: Consolidated material request for same item

posts.name: Nilesh Pithiya
posts.cooked:
Hello, I’m trying to find a way to create a single Material Request from multiple Production Plans. Currently, the system creates a separate request for each plan, which isn’t efficient for my procurement process.

Is there a simple way to combine the raw material requirements from several Production Plans into one Material Request?

if i have required 2 qty of abc item in 1 peoduction plan and i have a 2 production plan so in current system this generate 2 different material request and its hard manage for client so they want consolidate this abc item and make a single material request of qty 4 for this abc item.

how can i do this ?
